title: Remote Desktop is Enabled Without Network Level Authentication (NLA)
description: Network Level Authentication requires connecting clients to authenticate before creating an RDP session, protecting against BlueKeep and DoS.
impact: Unauthenticated attackers can exploit pre-authentication RDP vulnerabilities and cause resource exhaustion.
remediation_guidance: Require NLA for RDP: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp' -Name 'UserAuthentication' -Value 1

compliance_mappings.title: Require user authentication for remote connections by using Network Level Authentication

title: RDP Encryption Level is Weak
description: RDP sessions should enforce High encryption (128-bit) or FIPS-compliant encryption to protect credentials and screen buffers in transit.
impact: Remote desktop session traffic may be eavesdropped on or decrypted on compromised networks.
